A '''four-eyed''' [[Species/Legends|species]] existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. An individual of the species was a member of the [[Pendarran's Revenge]].

==Biology and appearance==
The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was bipedal in form, with a virtually bald head except a number of small growths around the crown. Members had four eyes&mdash;a set of larger eyes set lower in the head, with a second smaller pair set above these and closer together.<ref name="WBC" />

==History==
One member of the species belonged to the [[Pendarran's Revenge]], a para-military organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalm]]. [[Tattoo/Legends|Tattooed]] on its forehead was the Pendarran symbol, and it carried a large [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] as part of a mixed-species squad.<ref name="WBC" /> Another member of the species witnessed a [[seeker]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] immobilize a target in an alleyway.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species was first drawn by artist [[Mike Jackson]] in [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a [[West End Games]] roleplaying sourcebook published in [[1993]]. It later appeared in ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', published in [[1994]] in an illustration by [[Mike Vilardi]]. It appears Vilardi re-drew this species to provide visual continuity between sourcebooks. He has done this elsewhere with [[Unidentified stalk-eyed species|other species]] of his own creation.
